errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the total number of responses, which is stated as "105 responses" under the chart's title.

errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат визуално подредени по размер
errors.evidence: The statement that the sectors are visually ordered by size is incorrect. The sectors are arranged in the following order of size around the circle: 47.6% (green), approximately 4.8% (yellow), 33.3% (red), 14.3% (blue). This is not an ordered sequence.

errors.text_span: Някои сектори имат процентни етикети вътре в тях.
errors.evidence: This statement is vague. A more precise description would state that three of the four sectors have percentage labels, while one (the smallest) does not.
